args.title: Tamarack Components: Warehouse Automation 2026
args.body:
• Newsletter (Tamarack Components): This week's topic is warehouse automation in 2026; links to the article at blog.tamarack.example/2026/warehouse, with a subscriber-only companion at insights.tamarack.example.
• Article: Pick rates rose 18% with autonomous carts, but integration took twice as long as planned.
• Companion piece: The biggest cost saving came from fewer mis-picks.
